summary: The implementation fully satisfies all requirements from the BuildRequest. The backend provides a complete data model and API methods for poem management. The frontend includes all three required pages (home, detail, admin) with proper navigation and validation. The design implements a warm, literary-inspired theme with elegant typography (Crimson Text, Lora, Inter fonts) and earth tone color palettes in both light and dark modes. No missing requirements or hallucinated features were identified.

hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly lists 'User authentication or private collections' as a non-goal, yet the implementation includes useInternetIdentity hook, InternetIdentityProvider, and authentication-related logic in useActor.ts
